description: Not tax advice: arithmetic only. The 45-day identification and 180-day exchange deadlines of IRC §1031(a)(3) (the exchange period ends earlier at a given tax-return due date), the three-property, 200%, and 95% identification tests of Treas. Reg. §1.1031(k)-1(c)(4), and the cash boot, mortgage boot, debt replacement, and trade-down of an exchange, with the boot-limited gain when the basis is given. Deterministic: the same inputs always give the same result, with formula ID calc.exchange_1031@2, every step, and any warnings.

as_of.description: Date to count the days remaining from, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

cash_received_at_sale.description: Cash the taxpayer took from the sale proceeds instead of leaving them with the qualified intermediary, USD.

identified_properties.description: Replacement properties identified in writing. Empty to skip the identification checks.

fair_market_value.description: Fair market value at the end of the identification period, USD. Must be greater than 0.

identified_date.description: Date the written identification was delivered, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; checked against the 45-day deadline.

received.description: Whether the taxpayer acquired this property.

received_date.description: Date it was acquired, YYYY-MM-DD. Optional; checked against the exchange deadline.

adjusted_basis.description: Taxpayer's adjusted basis in the relinquished property, USD. Optional; adds the realized gain and the boot-limited gain.

debt_relieved.description: Mortgages and other liabilities paid off or assumed by the buyer at the sale, USD.

sale_price.description: Contract sale price (fair market value) of the relinquished property, USD. Also the base of the 200% identification test. Must be greater than 0.

selling_expenses.description: Exchange and closing expenses paid at the sale (commissions, title, QI fees), USD.

relinquished_transfer_date.description: Date the relinquished property was transferred (closed), YYYY-MM-DD. With several relinquished properties, the earliest transfer starts both periods.

replacement.description: The property acquired (in total). Omit to check only the deadlines and identification.

acquisition_costs.description: Closing costs paid at the purchase, USD.

new_debt.description: New or assumed mortgage debt on the replacement property, USD.

purchase_price.description: Total price of the replacement property or properties acquired, USD.

tax_return_due_date.description: Due date, including extensions, of the taxpayer's federal return for the year of the transfer, YYYY-MM-DD. IRC §1031(a)(3)(B) ends the exchange period on this date if it is earlier than day 180. FactLot does not compute it.

name: calc_exchange_1031
title: 1031 exchange deadlines, identification, and boot
